title: Paper plane
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='paper' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#dbe9ff'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='shade' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#a9c4ef'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#7d9fd8'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <g transform='translate(50 50) rotate(-12) translate(-50 -50)'>
    <!-- motion trail -->
    <path d='M8 78 L30 66' stroke='#7fd6ff' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
    <path d='M6 88 L24 78' stroke='#7fd6ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>
    <path d='M14 68 L28 60' stroke='#7fd6ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none' opacity='0.85'/>
    <!-- top wing -->
    <polygon points='26,44 84,26 46,54' fill='url(#paper)' stroke='#bcd4f5' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
    <!-- body / lower wing -->
    <polygon points='46,54 84,26 60,74' fill='#eef5ff' stroke='#bcd4f5' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
    <!-- keel under wing -->
    <polygon points='46,54 60,74 50,72' fill='url(#shade)' stroke='#8fb0e0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
    <!-- centre crease -->
    <line x1='46' y1='54' x2='84' y2='26' stroke='#9fbce6' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
